channel.title: Crypto Bulletin
channel.description: Crypto Bulletin reports crypto news on bitcoin, ethereum, stablecoins, exchanges, DeFi protocols, regulation, security incidents and market structure.

item.title: Samsung Wallet to add USDC remittances on 82M US Galaxy devices
item.description: Samsung will add USDC transfers to Wallet in late October for eligible users on 82 million US Galaxy devices, with bank payouts available in more than 60 countries.

item.title: Fairshake backs 32 House candidates with at least $6 million
item.description: Fairshake named 32 House candidates for 2026, pledging $1 million each to six as the crypto industry’s market-structure bill remains stalled in the Senate.

item.title: How to Compound SpookySwap Farm Rewards Into LP
item.description: Compounding SpookySwap farm rewards means harvesting BOO, converting the needed amount, adding liquidity to a chosen pair, then staking the LP tokens.

item.title: Solana Foundation launches DvP settlement program
item.description: Solana Foundation launched an open-source DvP program for atomic onchain settlement, with J.P. Morgan input and support for regulated token features.

item.title: Fairshake pledges $6 million to six House candidates
item.description: Fairshake named 32 House candidates for midterm support, pledging $1 million each to six as the stalled CLARITY Act leaves crypto policy unresolved.

item.title: Portal Bridge moves tokens across chains through Wormhole
item.description: Portal Bridge moves tokens between chains through Wormhole messaging, and the destination asset may be a wrapped version that must be redeemed on arrival.

item.title: Ondo launches private-market tokens with pre-IPO AI exposure
item.description: Ondo Finance introduced Ondo Private Markets on Oct. 5, offering notes tied to private-company value, with a pre-IPO AI market set to trade this week.

item.title: BNB Chain Token Trackers Need More Than a Familiar Symbol
item.description: BNB Chain trackers pair token symbols with contract addresses, prices and wallet activity; unusual Unicode can confuse searches, so verify the address before comparing charts or trading.

item.title: Ethereum Foundation launches private API payments with zkAPI
item.description: Ethereum launched zkAPI on Oct. 1, allowing users to pay for AI and other metered APIs with private credits while providers receive prompts without billing identities.

item.title: Base activates Cobalt with conditional transactions and B20 changes
item.description: Base activated Cobalt on Sept. 30, adding conditional transaction inclusion and three B20 tools for policy rules, scheduled balance displays and authorized transfers.

item.title: Treasury teams should verify bridge domains before signing
item.description: Treasury teams can verify a bridge domain by checking its exact hostname against project channels, then matching the route, wallet prompt and on-chain record.

item.title: Polygon treasury transfers need a staged schedule
item.description: Treasury teams can make Polygon-to-Ethereum transfers more predictable by batching requests, reserving gas and tracking each withdrawal through its final claim.

item.title: Blast to wind down Ethereum layer-2 after 98% asset drop
item.description: Blast will wind down its Ethereum layer-2 after costs overtook revenue, giving users until Oct. 26 to withdraw through its interface as locked value fell 98%.

item.title: How to Estimate Proceeds From Selling a Taxed Token
item.description: A taxed-token sale quote is only a starting point: check the sell fee, route output, slippage floor and network cost to estimate what reaches your wallet before signing.

item.title: Base V3 Ranges Should Match Your Holding Period
item.description: A V3 liquidity range should match how often you can manage it: wider bands need less attention, while narrow bands go inactive sooner when prices move.

item.title: Chart annotations keep crypto analysis tied to the right pair
item.description: Pair-specific chart annotations attach levels, lines and notes to one market, helping crypto traders track price structure without confusing pools or quote assets.

item.title: Why Test a Polygon Bridge Transfer Before Sending More?
item.description: A small test transfer can confirm the chosen Polygon route, wallet, token and destination address before you commit a larger balance to a cross-chain move.

item.title: Polygon Treasury Plan Must Account for Bridge Withdrawals
item.description: Polygon’s Community Treasury has a new strategy and execution split; moving assets back to Ethereum still requires a claim transaction and gas on both networks.

item.title: What a Polygon withdrawal burn does
item.description: A Polygon withdrawal burn destroys the bridged token on Polygon; after a validator checkpoint, an Ethereum claim releases the matching asset held in escrow.

item.title: Check the Route Before Signing a Cross-Chain Swap
item.description: Before signing a cross-chain swap, verify the chains, token contracts, minimum output, fees, destination address and every wallet request in the route.
